tenantStatus.new: Your landlord has received your report.
tenantStatus.under_review: Your landlord is looking at the problem.

confirm.under_review: The tenant will see that you are looking at the problem.
confirm.approved: The tenant will see that the repair is approved.
confirm.in_progress: The tenant will see that the repair has started.
confirm.resolved: The tenant will see that the problem is fixed. Tip: use “Record the repair” to also save what was done and the cost.
confirm.closed: The request will be closed. You can open it again later if needed.

nextHint.new: A tenant reported this problem. Look at it and decide what to do.
nextHint.under_review: When you decide to fix it, approve the repair.
nextHint.approved: When the repair person starts work, mark the repair as started.
nextHint.in_progress: When the work is finished, record the repair and its cost.
nextHint.resolved: The problem is fixed. You can close the request.
nextHint.closed: This request is closed. You can open it again if the problem comes back.

list.subtitle: All problems reported in your properties. Most urgent first when you sort by urgency.
list.emptyText: When a tenant reports a problem, it will appear here.

report.chooseCategory: Please choose the kind of problem.
report.describeExample: For example: “Water is leaking under the kitchen sink since this morning.”
report.describeRequired: Please describe the problem in a few words.
report.urgentHint: For example: a lot of water leaking, no electricity, a door that does not lock.
report.photosHelp: A photo helps your landlord understand the problem quickly.
report.photosOptional: Photos are optional. You can continue without them.
report.successTitle: Thank you! Your report {{reference}} was sent.
report.successText: Your landlord has been told. You will get a notification when there is news.

detail.providerHelp: The person or company who will do the repair. They do not need an account.
detail.internal: Private note (the tenant will not see it)
detail.internalHint: Leave unticked to share the message with the tenant.
detail.messageHint: For example: “The plumber will come tomorrow at 9:00.”
detail.resolvedNote: This problem is resolved. The repair is part of the property's maintenance history.

repair.title: Record the repair
repair.help: Save what was done and how much it cost. The cost is added to the property's expenses automatically.
repair.whatHint: For example: “Replaced the pipe under the sink.”
repair.costHint: Whole francs, for example 45000. Leave empty if free.
repair.expenseNote: This cost is counted once in Expenses, linked to this request.
